name: Werebat (PFS 3-13)

items.name: Studded Leather Armor
items.description: This leather armor is reinforced with metal studs and sometimes small metal plates, providing most of the flexibility of leather armor with more robust protection.

generalAbilities.name: Echolocation (Precise) 40 feet
generalAbilities.description: A werebat can use their hearing as a precise sense at the listed range.

defensiveAbilities.name: Wing Thrash
defensiveAbilities.description:
Trigger An adjacent enemy damages the werebat

Effect The werebat makes one or two wing Strikes, each against a different adjacent creature.

offensiveAbilities.name: Change Shape
offensiveAbilities.description: Human with Fist attack for (1d4+2) Bludgeoning Damage damage and no fly Speed. In hybrid form, their Speed changes to 25 feet and fly 25 feet.

offensiveAbilities.name: Curse of the Werebat
offensiveAbilities.description:
This curse affects only humanoids

Saving Throw DC 15 Fortitude Saving Throw DC.

On each full moon, the cursed creature must succeed at another Fortitude save or turn into a werebat until dawn. The creature is under the GM's control and goes on a rampage for half the night before falling unconscious until dawn.

offensiveAbilities.name: Moon Frenzy
offensiveAbilities.description: When a full moon appears in the night sky, the werebat must enter hybrid form and can't Change Shape thereafter. When the moon sets or the sun rises, the werebat returns to human form and is Fatigued for 2d4 hours.

recallKnowledge: Arcana or Nature or Society, DC 16
